slug: 2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards

facts.fact: Minister Boukar Michel announced on 2025-12-09 that authorities are finalizing a new digital law incorporating international standards on cybersecurity, data protection and internet governance.

systems.owner: Ministry of Telecommunications, Digital Economy and Administration Digitalization

systems.system: Law of 2014 on electronic communications and postal services, amended by ordinance approved by the National Assembly on 2025-10-22
